editorialNote: Five stories — vow → field → threshing floor → gate → child. The arc deliberately opens on Ruth's VOW (828, encouraging register), not Naomi's emptiness — Ruth is the relational center of every beat, even 1418 where Boaz is the manifest's primary character. Story order ratified in slate_v2_beat_review.md.

stories.label: Ruth 1 — 'where you go, I will go' (Ruth's vow on the road back to Bethlehem)
stories.editorialNote: Chosen over 1265 ('Where You Go, I Will Go' — same Ruth 1:1-22 pericope, hurting register, ALSO fully covered at six variants). The choice is REGISTER, not coverage: the arc opens on Ruth's vow, not Naomi's emptiness. 828 is fully covered (six variants: Short/Full/Long x WEB/KJV). Its bibleStoryKey 'ruth_and_naomi' is this journey's nameRegistryKey — registry entry + name clip are a before-ready gate, not yet present.

stories.label: Ruth 2:1-13 — Ruth in the field (gleaning behind the reapers, the day Boaz first noticed her)
stories.editorialNote: Chosen over 1036 (Ruth 2:1-23, ALSO fully covered at six variants) on QUALITY grounds: 1529 is from B29 (1527-1531), the locked lane-differentiation quality reference (feedback_b29_reference_batch). Fully covered (six variants). Scope is narrower than 1036's full chapter — the arc's beat is the meeting, not the whole gleaning season.

stories.label: Ruth 3:1-13 — at the threshing floor (Naomi's plan, Ruth by night, the nearer kinsman named)
stories.editorialNote: Coverage: WEB Short + KJV Short (KJV Short registered 2026-07-04). 1150's own ending introduces the nearer-kinsman obstacle that beat 3 carries forward. 1397 (Ruth 3:1-9, 'Who Are You' scene slice) excluded as redundant.

stories.label: Ruth 4:1-12 — Boaz at the gate (the nearer kinsman, the shoe, the elders as witnesses)
stories.editorialNote: primaryCharacterId is boaz (manifest-confirmed) — the arc's only non-Ruth-POV beat, kept because the gate scene IS the redemption hinge; the ratified beat text keeps Ruth the relational center per JOURNEY_TRANSITION_VOICE.md's different-figures note (slate_v2 carried flag). Coverage: WEB Short + KJV Short (KJV Short registered 2026-07-04).

stories.label: Ruth 4:13-17 — a son is born to Naomi (Obed on her lap, the neighbor women's blessing)
stories.editorialNote: The rest beat — the arc closes on the child and the blessing, not the genealogy. Coverage: WEB Short + KJV Short (KJV Short registered 2026-07-04). 1458 (Ruth 4:13-22, the-line-of-David extension) excluded to end on Naomi's lap, not the list.
